provenance.rule: Native44 synchronously establishes body43; a ch3 local correction must follow the matching binding in its actual packet prefix or an ACK of that binding.
provenance.limits: Prior create/controller ACKs are fixture inputs. Return uses the existing release helper. This does not establish native blackscreen/rewind causality or original ejection placement.

expected.before_binding: No local ch3 correction may bypass an in-flight binding; do not commit its mover send token.
expected.retry: Matching44 precedes local ch3 in the same candidate prefix; failed sends do not commit.
expected.after_ack: Normal latest command correction progresses without repeating44.
